column2: Okay... got it. Then, um, can you give Florin some orders for searching?{wait}{clear}
Angel, this is Arcaya, the world below!{wait}{clear}It's your first time here, so I thought I'd explain a few things. Would you like to hear?{wait}{clear}
Okay! Then I'll explain, just a little!{wait}{clear}Arcaya is made up of the Yerasel continent, the Kavakia peninsula and islands big and small, and it's divided into seven main lands.{wait}{clear}

First, in the north of the continent is the Grosain Empire, the mightiest power in Arcaya.{wait}{clear}Its capital is Reizefut, in the Reizefut region. It covers about a third of the continent, but a third of its land is frozen tundra.{wait}{clear}It has a really long history; they say it was once a great empire that ruled the whole continent.{wait}{clear}Even now it's a military nation with very disciplined knightly orders.{wait}{clear}

East of the Grosain Empire are the Duchy of Courrege and the Duchy of Zern.{wait}{clear}It's a really harsh land. It feels like the frontier of the continent, and not many people seem to live there.{wait}{clear}Maybe because of that, lots of old superstitions are still told there.{wait}{clear}I couldn't look closely into the lands north of Courrege, though. It just seems to be a place people are really afraid of.{wait}{clear}

South of the Empire is the Holy Nation of Ecclesia. It's a country united by its faith, and its capital is Araras, in Linares.{wait}{clear}It's been ruled by popes for generations, and the huge cathedral in the capital draws lots of faithful people.{wait}{clear}And in the Selva region is Lake Dreihaup, the largest lake on the Yerasel continent.{wait}{clear}

Southwest of the Empire and west of the Holy Nation is the Six Kingdoms Alliance, made up of six countries.{wait}{clear}Its six kingdoms, Labirk, Celesta, Lanas, Lefkas, Frezelecia and Basel, do lots of trade and are really wealthy.{wait}{clear}The central city is Alkmaar, in Basel, and ships leave from Suole, in Labirk. You can cross from there to the island in the west.{wait}{clear}
